chunks.text: CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 1 / 7 CARSURE / AIPL • CLIENT PROPOSAL Project Status & Delivery Plan Vehicle inspection, operational review and reporting platform Prepared for client review | 03 November 2026 | Version 2.0 Purpose of this document This document summarises the current Carsure modules, the proposed first deployment, upcoming development, required integrations and the client inputs needed to agree delivery dates. Scope at a glance • Current delivery: staff portals, Inspector workflow, operational review and approved report generation. • Upcoming: completion of the bank portal, provider integrations, report communication and selected finance modules. • Delivery estimates: expressed in working days and conditional on validated access, approved scope and timely acceptance feedback. Bank portal status The bank portal is not fully working and is excluded from the completed-module list and initial deployment commitment. CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 2 / 7 01 / CURRENT PROJECT STATUS Current modules The following modules have connected implementations in the current project. Release-specific testing and client acceptance are required before production use. Module Current scope Staff authentication and access Role-based staff and Inspector login, with tenant, branch and work-stream access controls. Staff users and branches User provisioning, role assignment, branch assignment and authorised administration. Leads and Jobs Operational intake, job listing/search, Inspector assignment, status tracking and job history. Inspector mobile workflow Assigned jobs, accept/reject, inspection steps, identity checks, checklists, photo/video evidence, offline drafts and upload retry. Supervisor review Inspection evidence review, approve/return/hold decisions, correction and resubmission. Report generation Predefined formats maintained in code, editable report inputs, preview, final PDF generation and authorised staff downloads. Portal notifications Role-scoped staff review alerts, unread counts and acknowledgement within the portal. AI review assistance Implemented photo/video damage suggestions and source-backed valuation research, subject to configured services and human review. Status interpretation An implemented module is not automatically a production-approved

CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 3 / 7 02 / ROLES AND DEPLOYMENT Proposed first release Role Primary responsibility Carsure Super Admin Platform/company administration and permitted oversight through the admin portal. AIPL QC Team Permitted QC and operational oversight through the admin portal. State Head Authorised regional/branch oversight and user administration. Company Admin Authorised branch operations, staff users, jobs and reports. Supervisor Inspection review, correction requests and permitted approval decisions. Inspector Assigned on-site inspections, checklist completion and evidence submission through the mobile app. Initial deployment package • Staff ERP and admin portals with the approved navigation and access matrix. • Backend API and database with controlled migration, backup and rollback arrangements. • Persistent evidence and report storage, with authorised uploads/downloads. • Approved predefined PDF formats and a supported Android Inspector pilot build. • AI assistance only where the approved account, budget and review rules are configured. Release approach Staging setup → representative workflow tests → client UAT → corrections and sign-off → controlled production pilot. The existing Docker

Android Inspector pilot build. • AI assistance only where the approved account, budget and review rules are configured. Release approach Staging setup → representative workflow tests → client UAT → corrections and sign-off → controlled production pilot. The existing Docker setup supports local development. Production hosting requires a separate deployment configuration, HTTPS, secure secrets, durable storage, backups and monitoring. The mobile container runs development tooling; Android deployment requires a release build and an agreed distribution method. The bank portal is excluded from this first-release scope. No bank-user availability or bank submission/report-download capability is committed until that module is completed and accepted.

CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 4 / 7 03 / UPCOMING DEVELOPMENT Modules planned for the next releases Module Proposed scope Bank portal — incomplete / upcoming Complete and validate bank-user accounts, dashboard, case creation, evidence upload, corrections, staff handover and released-report download. Proposed case types: Used Vehicle Inspection and Asset Verification. API integrations Validate and connect the agreed CStudio, VAHAN, Google Maps and WhatsApp services against client-owned accounts and actual provider documentation. Report communication Add a permitted staff action to email a final report, with recipient confirmation, approved content and send history. Agree WhatsApp report delivery separately. Proposed bank workflow — subject to completion Bank submission → staff review / correction → required valuation or verification → staff approval → final report → authorised bank download. The proposed bank evidence intake uses ten labelled images and a walk-around video of at least 30 seconds. Completion includes upload validation, case-type behaviour, correction/resubmission, permissions and end-to- end report-release testing. The client will approve the sequence of these modules. CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 5 / 7 04 / DEPENDENCIES Required APIs and AWS access Service Inputs required from the client CStudio Confirm exact product/provider and intended workflow. Provide API documentation, authentication method, sandbox access, sample requests/responses, webhook details where applicable and a technical contact. VAHAN Provide an authorised provider/account, approved lookup purpose, endpoint and authentication, sample vehicle results, quota/error documentation and test cases. Existing lookup code needs provider-specific validation. Google Maps Provide a client-owned project with billing, enabled APIs for the agreed map/address features, appropriately restricted keys, permitted domains/IPs and test locations. Existing address helpers need live configuration checks. WhatsApp Confirm provider, sender account/number, credentials, approved templates/languages, recipient consent rules, webhook access and test recipients. Final-report sending is additional to existing appointment-message foundations. AWS Provide a client-owned account, agreed region and budget, scoped deployment permissions, domain/DNS contact and technical owner. Agree compute, database, persistent storage, monitoring and backups. Prompts of Agents Developed on Carsure side Provide prompts of all the agents. Additional deployment decisions • Confirm

client-owned account, agreed region and budget, scoped deployment permissions, domain/DNS contact and technical owner. Agree compute, database, persistent storage, monitoring and backups. Prompts of Agents Developed on Carsure side Provide prompts of all the agents. Additional deployment decisions • Confirm storage retention, backup/restore objectives, supported usage volumes and production incident ownership. • For report email, select a provider such as Amazon SES and provide approved sender/domain access and required live sending permissions. • Provide the approved AI account and budget where AI-assisted workflows are included. Share credentials through an agreed secure channel. API charges, cloud usage charges and provider approval turnaround are outside development estimates. Accounts should remain client-owned.

CARSURE / AIPL PROJECT STATUS & DELIVERY PLAN Client review | 03 November 2026 | v2.0 • 6 / 7 05 / DELIVERY PROPOSAL Indicative delivery in working days Work package Estimate Start dependency Scope/access validation 2–3 working days Required documents, owners and initial access received. Core staging pilot and release preparation 5–8 working days Usable AWS/domain access, approved staff roles and report layouts. Bank portal excluded. VAHAN validation/integration 1–2 working days Authorised working sandbox, provider schema and test cases. Google Maps activation/testing 1-2 working days Enabled client project, valid keys and agreed features. Agreed WhatsApp workflow 1-2 working days Working provider account, approved templates, sender and test recipients. Staff report email action 2-3 working days Sender/provider access, recipient rules and approved email content. Integrated UAT and handover 4–6 working days In-scope implementation complete and consolidated client feedback received. Scheduling conditions Working days mean Monday–Friday, excluding agreed holidays. Each package starts on the next working day after its prerequisites are received, validated and its scope is approved.
